title: Topic 10: Food & Drink / Ordering - Vocabulary
description: Core words for food & drink / ordering: coffee, tea, milk, bread, rice, apple, juice, menu. 8 tap exercises with embedded grammar.
canDoStatement: Order food and drink in a cafe; say what you like
introductionText:
coffee = a hot, black drink  |  tea = a hot drink with
leaves  |  milk = a white drink  |  bread = you eat it
in the morning  |  rice = small and white, with lunch
apple = a red or green fruit  |  juice = a fruit drink
menu = the list of food and prices in a cafe
+ phrase bank: Can I have..., please? | Here you are. |
I like...
+ grammar note: a coffee, a tea BUT an apple (a-e-i-o-u
sound -> an)

vocabularyBlocks.title: Food & Drink / Ordering words
exampleSentences: Can I have a coffee, please?
Is there tea? Yes, there is.

grammarBlocks.title: A / AN full rule (G3: an + a-e-i-o-u sound: an apple) + CAN
grammarBlocks.explanation: A / AN full rule (G3: an + a-e-i-o-u sound: an apple) + CAN I HAVE...? polite requests (G11 intro) + I LIKE + noun (affirmative only - G7 pattern; do/does questions and negatives stay in Topic 16)
patterns: a + consonant sound (a coffee) / an + vowel
Can I have... please? (polite request chunk)

explanations.A1-T10-VOC-Q1: Milk = white drink. Coffee = black drink.
explanations.A1-T10-VOC-Q2: Menu = the list. Money (T9) pays for it!
explanations.A1-T10-VOC-Q4: You EAT bread. You DRINK tea and juice (T7 verbs!).
explanations.A1-T10-VOC-Q5: You eat rice. You drink tea and juice.
explanations.A1-T10-VOC-Q6: In a cafe, order with: Can I have..., please?
explanations.A1-T10-VOC-Q8: I like. He/she likeS (T7 rule - same -s!).
